info.name: HustleHub+ API (Part 2)
info.description: Full HustleHub+ Part 2 API collection: auth, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, and admin. Run top-to-bottom (Newman respects request order) - later requests depend on variables captured by earlier ones. Requires a running server with a connected MongoDB database (real Atlas or otherwise). The Admin folder requires an existing admin account matching the adminEmail/adminPassword environment variables (see the environment file notes).

request.description: Regression test for the category-filter injection fix (Phase B7). Must return 400, never 200 or 500.

item.name: Update Gig - Deposit Would Exceed Unchanged Price (rejected)

request.description: gigIdToDelete was soft-deleted in the Gigs folder, so it should no longer be bookable.

item.name: Get Booking By Id - Unrelated Client (rejected)

request.description: bookingId has a future bookingDate, so completion must be rejected until that date arrives.

exec: pm.test("includes a REMAINDER transaction", function () { const types = pm.response.json().data.transactions.map(t => t.type); pm.expect(types).to.include("REMAINDER"); });

request.description: Requires an existing admin account. Create one first with "npm run create-admin" (or SEED_ADMIN_ON_BOOT=true), using credentials matching the adminEmail/adminPassword collection variables - update those variables if your admin account differs.

exec: pm.test("finds our test client", function () { const emails = pm.response.json().data.users.map(u => u.email); pm.expect(emails).to.include("jordan.client@hustlehub.test"); });
pm.test("includes related-record counts", function () { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u).to.have.property("gigsCount"); pm.expect(u).to.have.property("bookingsCount"); });

request.description: Jordan (client2) never created a gig or a booking of their own, so they are safe to delete next.
The main freelancer has gigs and bookings, so deletion must be refused to protect that history.

exec: pm.test("includes the deactivated gig", function () { const statuses = pm.response.json().data.gigs.map(g => g.status); pm.expect(statuses).to.include("INACTIVE"); });
